get.description:
Returns the job in the plan output. The output can be retrieved either in a single step or in a different bunch of data (it generates a big output).
To retrieve the output in a single step, call the API without specifying any parameter.
To retrieve the output in a different bunch of data for the first time, specify the Lines parameter and set to 0 (zero) the pageNumber parameter. For the next bunch, you can specify other parameters for the pageNumber field.

parameters.name: fileId
parameters.description: Operation ID. Do not define it in the first call.

parameters.name: lines
parameters.description: The number of lines. When defined, do not modify the value.

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: The number of the page. The job log can be consecutive only.

200.description: The output has been correctly retrieved.

maxResults.name: maxResults
maxResults.description: The maximum number of results to be returned by the evaluation.

Query-PageSize.name: Query-PageSize
Query-PageSize.description: The number of elements (max 10000) contained in a single returned page in plan queries. It is used only with the current plan and mirroring enabled. The default value is 10000. It is mutual exclusive with How-Many.

Query-PageNumber.name: Query-PageNumber
Query-PageNumber.description: The offset of the first object to return in the plan queries. It is used only with the current plan and mirroring enabled. The default value is 0. It is mutual exclusive with How-Many.

Last-Object.name: Last-Object
Last-Object.description: Identificative string of the last object (or objects) returned in the last query

howManyHeader.name: How-Many
howManyHeader.description: The number of objects (max 10000) to be retrieved with a query on a first bunch of object. Use 0 (zero) to retrieve all the objects that match the given filter in one shot. It is mutual exclusive with Query-PageSize and Query-PageNumber.

howManyHeaderNotMutual.name: How-Many
howManyHeaderNotMutual.description: The number of objects (max 10000) to be retrieved with a query on a first bunch of object. Use 0 (zero) to retrieve all the objects that match the filter simultaneously.

force.name: force
force.description: Set it to true if the object must be unlocked even if the requesting user is currently holding the lock using another session or if the lock is held by another user and the requesting user has sufficient rights to unlock it.

isLocked.name: isLocked
isLocked.description: Set it to true if the object is expected to be locked by the user or false if it is expected to be unlocked.

unlock.name: unlock
unlock.description: Set it to true if the object must be unlocked after the requested update has been applied.

lock.name: lock
lock.description: Set it to true if the object must be locked while being retrieved. By default, it is false.

name.name: name
name.description: This parameter is mutually exclusive with the "key" parameter. Either "key" or "name" is required.

key.name: key
key.description: This parameter is mutually exclusive with the "name" parameter. Either "key" or "name" is required.

contextSessionHeader.name: Context-Session
contextSessionHeader.description: Name of the session. It is required for lock and unlock operations

contextSessionForInternalLockHeader.name: Context-Session
contextSessionForInternalLockHeader.description: Name of the session. It is required if the lock parameter is true.

contextJobStreamScopeHeader.description:

3=The scope integer used to identify the whole content of a job stream, except for run cycles

5=The scope integer used to identify the whole content of a job stream

contextPlanDependenciesScopeHeader.description:
0=Disables loading of dependencies in plan queries
1=Enables loading of dependencies in plan queries

contextTransferModeHeader.name: Context-TransferMode
contextTransferModeHeader.description:
Defines how data are retrieved by engine. 0=The transfer mode integer used to specify that plan query results must be transferred in objects
1=The transfer mode integer used to specify that plan query results must be transferred in bytes

contextStatusScopeHeader.name: Context-StatusScope
contextStatusScopeHeader.description:

contextUseCacheHeader.name: Context-UseCache
contextUseCacheHeader.description:
0=Load Information without using the cache
